nodes.name: Manual Marks Queue Trigger
nodes.notes: Reads only newly appended rows from the Teacher Marks Submission spreadsheet Automation Queue, columns A:P.

nodes.name: Normalize Manual Marks Queue Row
nodes.notes: Validates the queue state, captured teacher email, declaration and one-line-per-student marks format. Produces one stable service RPC request.

nodes.name: Is Manual Queue Row Processable?
nodes.notes: Processes only exact pending marks.batch.submit queue rows. All other rows terminate without side effects.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { 'p_request': { 'operation':'workflow.run.log', 'correlation_id': $('Normalize Manual Marks Queue Row').item.json.request.correlation_id, 'idempotency_key': $('Normalize Manual Marks Queue Row').item.json.request.idempotency_key + ':workflow-start', 'source':{'channel':'n8n'}, 'payload':{ 'workflow_code':'03-marks-intake', 'n8n_execution_id':$execution.id, 'operation':'marks.batch.submit', 'run_status':'started', 'input_summary':{'form_response_id':$('Normalize Manual Marks Queue Row').item.json.queue.formResponseId,'mark_count':$('Normalize Manual Marks Queue Row').item.json.markCount} } } } }}

nodes.name: Log Manual Workflow Start
nodes.notes: Best-effort durable start evidence. Logging failure cannot block marks submission.

nodes.name: Submit Manual Marks RPC
nodes.notes: Calls the service-role-only code-resolving marks wrapper. The RPC verifies teacher assignment, class membership, ranges and finalization rules.

nodes.name: Build Manual Queue Outcome
nodes.notes: Converts the transport and RPC result into sanitized queue status fields without exposing stack traces or credentials.

nodes.name: Update Manual Automation Queue
nodes.notes: Updates exactly one marks queue row by immutable Form Response ID.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { 'p_request': { 'operation':'workflow.run.log', 'correlation_id': $('Normalize Manual Marks Queue Row').item.json.request.correlation_id, 'idempotency_key': $('Normalize Manual Marks Queue Row').item.json.request.idempotency_key + ':workflow-completion', 'source':{'channel':'n8n'}, 'payload':{ 'workflow_code':'03-marks-intake', 'n8n_execution_id':$execution.id, 'operation':'marks.batch.submit', 'run_status': $('Build Manual Queue Outcome').item.json.success ? 'completed' : 'failed', 'output_summary':{'queue_status':$('Build Manual Queue Outcome').item.json['Processing Status'],'marks_batch_id':$('Build Manual Queue Outcome').item.json.marksBatchId,'batch_status':$('Build Manual Queue Outcome').item.json.batchStatus}, 'error_code':$('Build Manual Queue Outcome').item.json['Error Code'], 'error_message':$('Build Manual Queue Outcome').item.json['Error Message'] } } } }}

nodes.name: Log Manual Workflow Completion
nodes.notes: Runs only after the queue outcome is durably written. Logging remains best effort.

nodes.name: Skip Manual Non-Pending Queue Row
nodes.notes: Expected terminal for completed, failed, stale or operation-mismatched queue rows.

nodes.name: Marks File Queue Trigger
nodes.notes: Reads only new Automation Queue rows from the Marks CSV or Excel Upload response spreadsheet, columns A:P.

nodes.name: Normalize Marks File Queue Row
nodes.notes: Validates strict pending state, captured teacher email, form context, Drive URL, declared file name and CSV/XLS/XLSX type.

nodes.name: Is File Queue Row Processable?
nodes.notes: Processes only exact pending marks.file.submit rows.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { 'p_request': { 'operation':'workflow.run.log', 'correlation_id': $('Normalize Marks File Queue Row').item.json.correlationId, 'idempotency_key': $('Normalize Marks File Queue Row').item.json.idempotencyKey + ':workflow-start', 'source':{'channel':'n8n'}, 'payload':{'workflow_code':'03-marks-intake','n8n_execution_id':$execution.id,'operation':'marks.file.submit','run_status':'started','input_summary':{'form_response_id':$('Normalize Marks File Queue Row').item.json.queue.formResponseId,'file_name':$('Normalize Marks File Queue Row').item.json.originalFileName}}} } }}

nodes.name: Log File Workflow Start
nodes.notes: Best-effort start evidence for the file-upload branch.

nodes.name: Download Marks File
nodes.notes: Downloads the teacher-provided Drive file into binary field data. Provider errors continue to the queue failure classifier.

nodes.name: Validate Downloaded Marks File
nodes.notes: Confirms binary download and actual supported file extension. Builds a sanitized queue failure when download validation fails.

nodes.name: Is Download Ready?
nodes.notes: Routes valid binary files to native extraction.

nodes.name: Is CSV File?
nodes.notes: Routes CSV separately from Excel formats.

nodes.name: Extract CSV Marks
nodes.notes: Uses the native Extract From File node with the first row as headers. Parsing errors continue for queue classification.

nodes.name: Is XLSX File?
nodes.notes: Routes XLSX separately from legacy XLS.

nodes.name: Extract XLSX Marks
nodes.notes: Uses the native Extract From File node and reads the Marks sheet with a header row.

nodes.name: Extract XLS Marks
nodes.notes: Supports legacy Excel XLS files using the same Marks-sheet contract.

nodes.name: Build File Marks Request
nodes.notes: Aggregates extracted rows and converts duplicate or malformed file data into durable failed queue outcomes instead of terminating the execution.

nodes.name: Is File Request Ready?
nodes.notes: Prevents malformed files from reaching the marks RPC.

nodes.name: Submit File Marks RPC
nodes.notes: Submits the normalized file batch through the same service-role-only marks wrapper used by manual entry.

nodes.name: Build File Queue Outcome
nodes.notes: Converts transport and RPC output into sanitized queue fields.

nodes.name: Update File Automation Queue
nodes.notes: Updates exactly one upload queue row by immutable Form Response ID.

nodes.name: Log File Workflow Completion
nodes.notes: Best-effort completion evidence after the upload queue is updated.

nodes.name: Skip File Non-Pending Queue Row
nodes.notes: Expected terminal for completed, failed, stale or operation-mismatched upload queue rows.
